2610.06843.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
2610.06843.paper_summary: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
2610.06843.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人透過文本記憶來協調冷凍的視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 策略，這種記憶記錄了代理人所做的事情，但並不記錄任務是如何完成的。演示視頻展示了這一點，但與代理人的上下文不太契合。完整視頻在每次轉換時都會變得緩慢，固定的關鍵幀失去了決定抓取是否成功的接觸細節，而代理人在規劃時所需的內容從任務的結構轉移到了每個接觸周圍的幀。 我們引入了遞歸視頻上下文學習 (RV-ICL)，這是一種無需訓練的方法，將演示轉變為代理人導航的層次結構，而不是它收到的提示。該層次結構由演示的子事件構成，例如抓取和釋放。其層級變得更加細緻，從整個任務的關鍵幀到階段、時刻和短片，並通過只讀工具展示。代理人在規劃之前會閱讀粗略層級。在執行過程中，當某一步需要更多細節時，它會重新進入層次結構，並僅加載當前子目標的片段。每個任務只需一個演示即可。基於 RPent，RV-ICL 將 LIBERO-PRO 的成功率從 92.6% 提高到 96.5%，將 LIBERO-Plus 的成功率從 86.7% 提高到 95.8%。
